title: Re-eval of exp 094 (dirty/read string reuse) under A11c
impact: Even under A11c fan-out (~50× amplification of read-set/dirty-set add traffic), deltas were within noise on every workload the change targets (disjoint +4%, overlap −2%, concurrent reads ±10% — all inside MDE_ci). Empirically validates 094's original "below noise floor" rejection.
